verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents offline evaluation: you run your application against curated, manually authored, or synthetically generated datasets during development to create experiments. This lets you test separately from live production traffic. However, the evidence never describes a dedicated sandbox or staging environment, or any isolation guarantee between test and production data. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test-mode environment, documented isolation of test runs from production data and projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
